name: light-the-hunt-buff-two-counters
notes: Light the Hunt (edjgscy50x, GeneratedMacroCode.php cardActivatedAbilities["edjgscy50x:0"] builds an MZCHOOSE of Animal/Beast allies; customDQHandlers["edjgscy50x:0:CardActivated-1"] applies AddCounters($player, $chosen, "buff", 2)): "Put two buff counters on target Animal or Beast ally you control." A Cheerful Slime (ANIMAL) is seeded onto the field as the target; Light the Hunt is LUXEM, so the champion's Subcards are patched with Zander, Blinding Steel's lineage for element access. Verified live: the Slime's Counters go from {} to {"buff":2}. Break/restore verified: commenting out the AddCounters() call makes the fixture fail and restoring it passes again. (The separate '[Class Bonus][Element Bonus] whenever you reveal this card from your memory, put a buff counter on an Animal or Beast ally' clause lives under a different dispatch key (revealAbilities["edjgscy50x:0"]) and is not covered by this fixture.)

rulesClauses: Put two buff counters on target Animal or Beast ally you control.
